title: Bless India Posters
desktopOnly: Desktop only for now — this large poster isn’t yet proven to print safely on a phone.
intro: Every India people group on one printable sheet, generated live and shown as its printable sheets with glue strips — the way Poster Design's Sizes view shows the big formats.
generating: Generating the poster from the live data…
photos: Only {real} of {total} India groups have a photo in the data; a printed document carries them, a flat image can't. This numbered design prints names without photos so every group is equal and legible.
